ministries.name: Children's Ministry
ministries.summary: The Children's Ministry provides pastoral care and Christian teaching for children from infancy through their teenage years.
ministries.details: Through Sunday School and Teens Fellowship, children are helped to know Christ, grow in the Word, worship, pray, develop their gifts and receive pastoral support at church, home and school.

ministries.name: Evangelism Ministry
ministries.summary: The Evangelism Ministry shares the Gospel and supports the growth of the Christian faith through outreach and mission.
ministries.details: Its work includes reaching homes and communities, schools, health facilities and prisons, as well as organizing evangelistic activities, missions and acts of service that help draw people to Christ.

ministries.name: Hospitality Ministry
ministries.summary: The Hospitality Ministry reflects the love of Christ by creating a welcoming, caring and supportive environment for members and visitors.
ministries.details: Through ushering, care and follow-up, the ministry helps people feel accepted, supported and connected to the church community.

ministries.name: Married's Ministry
ministries.summary: The Married's Ministry supports couples in building strong Christian marriages and families through biblical teaching, fellowship, peer learning and mutual support.
ministries.details: Through the Women's Fellowship, Men's Fellowship and marriage preparation activities, members are encouraged to grow spiritually and support one another through the opportunities and challenges of family life.

ministries.name: Maturity Ministry
ministries.summary: The Maturity Ministry nurtures believers toward spiritual maturity, helping them become deeply rooted in Christ and equipped for ministry.
ministries.details: Through prayer and intercession for the church, together with sound Bible teaching and practical discipleship, the ministry seeks to strengthen reliance on God, develop Christ-like character and equip believers to live according to God's Word.

ministries.name: Music Ministry
ministries.summary: The Music Ministry leads the church in worship and helps create an environment where people can encounter and glorify God through music and other creative expressions.
ministries.details: Through praise and worship, instruments and related forms of ministry, it encourages believers to develop a genuine lifestyle of worship both in church and in everyday life.

ministries.name: Youth Ministry
ministries.summary: The Youth Ministry helps young people know Christ, grow in their faith and discover their calling to serve God.
ministries.details: It encourages young people to develop a personal relationship with God, participate in ministry and grow spiritually, socially, physically and economically while living as examples of Christian faith.

ministries.name: Administration
ministries.summary: Administration coordinates the day-to-day activities and programmes of the church and helps ensure they are organized and carried out properly.
ministries.details: It supports areas including the Pastor's Office, church services and fellowships, conferences, finance and accountability, estates, church property and communication/publicity.
